text:
rahul: Quick heads-up — please hold on merging PR #21587 (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/21587). mac-e2e smoke is flaky and we don't want to risk landing before the nightly deploy freeze starts tonight.

lena: Which failure are we seeing? flaky tests or infra timeouts?

rahul: Intermittent UI click flake on mac-android combo. Fails in ~20% of runs, passes on rerun. CI logs show a JS timeout at `HomePage.test.js:43`.

noah: Can we swap priority with my small telemetry PR (21499)? That one is tiny and quick to land if it helps the queue.

rahul: Yes please if you can take a small priority bump. I'd prefer to wait on 21587 until mac-e2e is green.

ci-bot: mac-e2e queued (job id: 8812). Currently 1 running, 3 pending. Rerun link: https://ci.redwood.test/job/8812

lena: If we need a rebase window, we have until 23:45 UTC for the pre-freeze cutover. After that, no merges until freeze lifts.

rahul: Noted. I'm going to push a tiny debounce fix in a follow-up patch to reduce flakiness; will request a fast review.

noah: I can review the debounce change quickly. Ping me when it's up and I'll approve if it looks sane.

rahul: Thanks — PR 21588 created with the debounce patch, added description and CI steps. @noah please take a look.

ci-bot: mac-e2e result: smoke suite PASS (run 8812) — all tests green.

release-coordinator: We can allow a canary landing for 21587 after the debounce PR is merged and CI stays green. Keep the merge in the next 15 minutes window to avoid blocking the freeze schedule.

lena: Can we land 21588 first, then run a quick canary for 21587? That sequence minimizes rollback blast radius.

rahul: Sounds good. Merging 21588 now, will request canary for 21587 after a green post-merge CI.

noah: Approved 21588 — looks fine. :thumbsup:

rahul: Merged 21588 and kicked off canary CI for 21587. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

release-coordinator: Canary started — monitor logs and call the canary abort if anything odd within 10 minutes.

rahul: Will do. If all good, I'll land 21587 into main within the next slot. Thanks again.

noah: Good job everyone, smooth and quick.

rahul: Closing the loop — landed 21587 to main at 1740000024.
